## Taxonomy Stage

**Purpose:** Propose a closed set of theme clusters, then require a human to lock it before anything downstream can reference it.

**TODO:**
1. LLM node A + LLM node B (two models/providers): each brainstorms candidate themes from titles/abstracts (optionally seeded with an embedding-based clustering signal from Qdrant — advisory only).
2. Code node: merge + dedupe proposed themes into a single candidate list.
3. Wait node (HUMAN GATE): present the candidate taxonomy; pause until a human approves/edits it.
4. Postgres node: insert into `clusters`, set `locked = true` only after approval.

No document may be classified (Stage 05) against an unlocked taxonomy.
